correctness.rationale: Explicit Hermitian dimer Schur complement gives Sigma=2m(E+c)/(E²-1); exact one-channel scattering yields the rational transmission. Cubic endpoint signs and degree show the exhaustive m=1/2/≥3 reflection count. An ℓ² eigenstate at an interior wire-band energy must vanish on the wire and hub, reducing BIC classification to two dimer eigenspaces with a single hub sum constraint. The implicit function theorem at weak flux yields a transverse pair of asymmetric half-reflection crossings. The standalone direct finite-Hamiltonian solver passed 345 supplementary checks. All boundaries, parameters and proof limits are stated in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: The exactly solvable many-loop interference device has a motivated natural counting question: how many complete backscattering frequencies survive adding identical loop channels? Its sharp three-loop stabilization boundary, simultaneously extensive compact BIC multiplicities and exact asymmetric flux² local notch shape distinguish a structural transport law from a cosmetic reparameterization or isolated arithmetic sample. The linewidth coefficient shrinks as inverse loop count at fixed weak flux. No general many-body claim is made.
